recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-33942 unless a future work group decision changes the semantics of _total or Bundle.total estimates.
issue_request: FHIR-33942 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Feed and applied for R5. It requested clarification that Bundle.total in searchset Bundles may be an estimate, adding explicit searchset narrative that full iteration or _total=accurate are the only reliable exact-count mechanisms and changing the Bundle.total definition to say the total is potentially estimated.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied in commit 30c5d5f934984dbf392d563c3e48693061af5f1f, which added the requested estimate text to source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml and the '(potentially estimated)' wording to source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml. That commit batched FHIR-33942 with FHIR-17060, FHIR-8025, and FHIR-35830, but the FHIR-33942 hunks are identifiable.
additional_context: Bundle is in current build scope through the active source/fhir.ini [resources] entry bundle=Bundle. Later FHIR-48485 updated Bundle.total for search-or-history context while preserving the FHIR-33942 estimate clarification. FHIR-I minutes for 2021-09-27 corroborate the Persuasive with Modification vote, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml already states that Bundle.total MAY be an estimate and source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml already says Bundle.total is potentially estimated. The Search page's _total section was checked and does not contradict this; adding another copy of the Bundle narrative there would be redundant.
